offering_description.value: WEX provides fuel and fleet payments to commercial and government fleets, employee benefits administration to employers, and virtual payments to businesses. It delivers these offerings through payment cards, online software, merchant networks and banking services.

primary_products.value: Fleet fuel cards; fleet expense management software; benefits administration software; virtual payment cards

primary_services.value: Fleet payment processing; health and commuter benefits account administration; COBRA administration; corporate and travel payment processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial fleet operators, employers, benefits administrators, online travel agencies and corporate accounts payable teams; B2G: Government agencies that operate vehicle fleets

end_markets.value: Trucking and commercial fleets; government fleets; employee health and commuter benefits; travel and hospitality; corporate accounts payable

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Fees tied to fleet card purchases and corporate virtual card payments; service fees: Benefits account administration, COBRA administration and account servicing; subscription: Recurring access fees for fleet and expense management software; interest or premiums: Interest and finance charges on commercial payment balances
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; subscription; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects merchants and payment networks with fleets, benefits administrators and corporate buyers; service provider: Processes payments and administers employer-sponsored benefit accounts; financial intermediary: Issues commercial payment cards, extends credit and holds deposits through its banking subsidiary
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States and Canada, with operations in Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Fleet payments and expense management, employee benefits administration, and corporate and travel payments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving fleet operators, employers and corporate accounts; online: Online applications for fleet cards and digital enrollment portals; partners / resellers: Fuel retailers, financial institutions, benefits administrators and business software providers; agents / brokers: Employee benefits brokers and consultants
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; partners / resellers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Its Utah-chartered industrial bank is supervised by the FDIC and the Utah Department of Financial Institutions
